Local rules that affect duplexes in South Surrey Luxury Homes

items.t: SSMUH position (Surrey side): Duplexes are the baseline form under the provincial framework. Surrey allows a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop (Jul 8, 2024 changes).

Taxes and servicing (Surrey side): Surrey property taxes are due July 2, with a 5% penalty if not paid by midnight July 2 and a further 5% penalty after September 2; servicing is under Bylaw 8830 (1986), verified; a short-term rental licence is $358/yr with the 2024 $350/yr proposal disclosed; Surrey has no Supreme Court registry.
